name: Gun mantlets and cradles
boundary: Box castings and cradle supports; bespoke cast/lofted mantlets retain their outlines.

name: Track drive sprockets
boundary: Single/twin rims, tooth count and exactly one X-axis wheel registration.

name: Bumpers
boundary: Dimensioned steel/moulded box sections; bent tubular bars and body-integral noses remain authored.

name: Aircraft pitots
boundary: Exact endpoints; tapered probe and sleeve. Refuelling booms are not pitots.

name: Radar covers and arrays
boundary: Flat scanner/array and ellipsoid cover styles; exposed dishes remain specialised.

name: Towing jaws
boundary: Open jaws with vertical pin; tow balls and weapon pintles remain distinct.

name: Stowage baskets
boundary: Open floor, rails and stanchions; keep cargo outside the helper.

name: Engine cowlings
boundary: Authored helicopter station loops with skin, seams and fasteners; aircraft nozzle and inlet topology remains specific.

name: Light guards
boundary: Four family adapters retain optics and use one cage/foot builder.

name: Crane booms
boundary: Endpoint or box adapters retain folded pose and hydraulics; rescue winch housings remain local.

name: Dashboards
boundary: Three open ground cabs; hull-shaped marine consoles retain their shell.

name: Steering wheels
boundary: Ring, spokes and hub with caller-owned column.

name: Marine screws
boundary: Pitched blades and hub; rudders and waterjets are separate assemblies.

name: Cargo sideboards
boundary: Flat leaves and ribs; authored stake posts and open tailgate angles remain local.

name: Sensor masts
boundary: Stage dimensions and collars; heads and pan parents unchanged.

name: Gun receivers
boundary: Receiver shells and feed-cover hardware; barrels, feed boxes and sockets remain local.

name: Aircraft skid runners
boundary: Shared runner path; drone and helicopter cross-strut layouts remain local.

name: Fuel filler caps
boundary: Explicit outward normal, gasket, neck and cap grip.

name: Wire cutters
boundary: Blade profile and fasteners with original attachment axes.

name: Slat armour
boundary: Horizontal/vertical open panels; hull stand-offs stay authored.

name: Service hose reels
boundary: Wound pack, flanges and hub on three truck families.

name: Door and ramp leaves
boundary: Existing body, ramp and gear panels; preserves hardware and moving parents.
